_about: Where a ship picture's engines are, when ThrusterFx's finder (the rearmost pixels, ThrusterFx.for_sprite) gets it wrong. Keyed by the picture's file name without .png; coordinates in that picture's own pixels (the full-size file; a _half picture halves them). Each engine is a column x and rows y0..y1: every row walks back from x to the first open pixel behind the hull and the flame starts there. An empty list is a ship with no flame at all. Hand-placed Oct 13 off Jon's gallery of every ship; read each picture before adding one.

ship_asteroidtow.why: the tug's own engine; the rock it tows is the rearmost thing in the picture

ship_bigdish.why: the lit tail engine only; the dish's rim reaches further back

ship_scoop.why: the drive pod under the hull; the scoop's prong tips reach further back

hulk_honeycomb.why: the centre engine only; the tail fins reach as far

hulk_rs_net.why: the hull's own stern between the net's fins

lancer_solarsail.why: the hull's rounded stern between the sails, not the sail tips
